description: Session advertises eventSourceUrl but the endpoint is not wired. Clients cannot receive real-time state change notifications. SSE is the minimum push mechanism required by RFC 8620 section 7.3.
notes: Superseded by stoa-v64xb (JMAP over WebSocket / RFC 8887). WebSocket is the preferred push transport; SSE is the fallback. Implement WebSocket first.
title: Wire EventSource push endpoint
